select "o"."id", "o"."number", "o"."status", "o"."version", "o"."total_minor", "o"."created_at", "c"."name" from "suite"."orders" as "o" inner join "suite"."customers" as "c" on "o"."customer_id" = "c"."id" and "o"."workspace_id" = "c"."workspace_id" where "o"."workspace_id" = $1 order by "o"."id" limit $2

select "m"."module_id", "m"."state", "e"."active", "a"."membership_id" from "suite"."module_activations" as "m" inner join "suite"."entitlements" as "e" on "m"."workspace_id" = "e"."workspace_id" and "m"."module_id" = "e"."module_id" left join "suite"."module_assignments" as "a" on "a"."workspace_id" = "m"."workspace_id" and "a"."module_id" = "m"."module_id" and "a"."membership_id" = $1 where "m"."workspace_id" = $2 and "m"."module_id" in ($3, $4)

select "r"."id", "r"."name", "r"."permissions", "a"."membership_id" from "suite"."roles" as "r" left join "suite"."role_assignments" as "a" on "a"."role_id" = "r"."id" and "a"."workspace_id" = "r"."workspace_id" and "a"."membership_id" = $1 where "r"."workspace_id" = $2
select * from "suite"."module_releases" where (("module_id" = $1 and "version" = $2) or ("module_id" = $3 and "version" = $4))

select "u"."id", "u"."name", "u"."email", "u"."email_verified", "u"."active", "s"."csrf_token", "s"."mfa" from "suite"."sessions" as "s" inner join "suite"."users" as "u" on "s"."user_id" = "u"."id" where "s"."token_hash" = $1 and "s"."expires_at" > $2

select "m"."id", "w"."kind", "p"."value" as "policy" from "suite"."memberships" as "m" inner join "suite"."workspaces" as "w" on "w"."id" = "m"."workspace_id" left join "suite"."platform_settings" as "p" on "p"."workspace_id" = "m"."workspace_id" and "p"."key" = $1 where "m"."workspace_id" = $2 and "m"."user_id" = $3 and "m"."active" = $4
